candidate_code_list.code_explanation: A dbt generic data test (SQL/Jinja) named is_even that validates a column contains only even numbers. It selects rows where the column mod 2 equals 1 (odd) and returns them as validation errors. Use this as a reusable test referenced from model/source/seed/schema YAML.

macros:  
  - name: test_not_empty_string  
    description: Complementary test to default `not_null` test as it checks that there is not an empty string. It only accepts columns of type string.  
    arguments:  
      - name: model   
        type: string  
        description: Model Name  
      - name: column_name  
        type: string  
        description: Column name that should not be an empty string
candidate_code_list.code_explanation: A schema.yml documentation snippet for a custom test macro (test_not_empty_string). It documents the macro name, a human-readable description, and argument metadata (model and column_name). Placed under macros: in a YAML file to surface docstrings/argument descriptions in dbt documentation.

A dbt generic relationships test that checks referential integrity: it finds child rows whose non-null id does not exist in the parent table. The test accepts extra arguments (field and to) in addition to model and column_name for specifying the parent key and parent relation.

A dbt generic test that sets a default config (severity = 'warn') and selects rows where a column is odd. Any rows returned produce a warning-level test result unless overridden when the test is instantiated.

An example of overriding dbt's built-in unique generic test by defining a test block named unique in the project's tests/generic folder. dbt will prefer this project-local implementation over the global builtin.
